method.description: Actually visually inspected four chronological contact sheets with view_image, sampling every fourth frame plus final frame, and the exact approved source image individually. FFmpeg CPU decoding limited to two threads; no GPU or processor used.

observations: Eight separately traceable arms (four per side) and their coral inner panels persist across all 32 sampled frames, including downward-curled and outward-spread poses; no arm loss, duplication or fusion observed.

Meaningful gentle repeated arm waving accompanies restrained body movement, a brief closed-eye blink around frames 64-68 and a smiling mouth opening. The character remains coherent; no unintended anatomical morphing observed.
Yellow sailor hat with blue band stays attached. Orange starfish, green seaweed and turquoise shell remain present, recognizable and without added faces.
All artwork remains inside the frame with white margins; no cropping or disappearing decorations observed. Colors and overall composition remain faithful to the approved source.
limitations: This is sampled visual inspection, not realtime playback or inspection of every frame. Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
